out.explanation: Page 369 shows that Total Secured Loans (3) of 499.48 million includes both fund-based and non-fund-based limits (Total Fund Based of 88.85 million plus Total Non-Fund Based Limits of 410.63 million), whereas Statement A on page 369 refers strictly to the Total Fund Based borrowings of 88.85 million. They measure different scopes of borrowing rather than contradicting the same figure.
